chapter_title: A Question of Price (एक सवाल कीमत का)

acts.act_name: The Ritual Bath & Castellan Haxo's Warning
acts.narrative_summary: Geralt is scrubbed, shaved, and dressed in aristocratic finery as Lord Ravix of Fourhorn. Castellan Haxo warns him of Queen Calanthe's dangerous cunning and rumors of a monster haunting the royal banquet.

acts.act_name: The Banquet of Cintra & Queen Calanthe's Royal Parley
acts.narrative_summary: In the magnificent banquet hall of Cintra, suitors from Skellige and Attre gather for Princess Pavetta's hand. Queen Calanthe seats Geralt beside her, demanding he slay a threat to the throne under the guise of an honorable guest.

acts.act_name: The Arrival of the Urcheon of Erlenwald
acts.narrative_summary: The heavy iron doors swing open. A knight in battered, rusted plate armor with a lowered helm strides in, declaring himself Urcheon of Erlenwald to claim his promised reward.

acts.act_name: The Law of Surprise & The Sacred Vow
acts.narrative_summary: Duny recounts saving late King Roegner and invoking the ancient Law of Surprise. Princess Pavetta is escorted into the hall, and Mousesack the druid confirms Destiny's unyielding power.

acts.act_name: The Midnight Unmasking & The Clashing Steel
acts.narrative_summary: At the stroke of midnight, Duny is forced to remove his helmet, exposing his grotesque bristled beast head. Calanthe commands him seized; Rainfarn attacks, and a savage hall brawl erupts as Geralt defends Duny.

Terrified by the violence against Duny, Pavetta screams, releasing uncontrollable primordial Elder Blood telekinesis that rips tapestries, floats tables, and shatters stone. Geralt and Mousesack combine their magical wills to quell the vortex.

acts.act_name: The Dawn of Destiny & The Child of Surprise
acts.narrative_summary: Calanthe's acceptance breaks the curse, transforming Duny into a noble youth. Eist proposes to Calanthe. In gratitude, Duny offers Geralt anything he desires; Geralt invokes the Law of Surprise on Pavetta's unborn child, binding his destiny to Ciri.
